root_cause.text: The UDP receive path failed to clear the skb's destructor (set by the skmsg layer via skb_set_owner_sk_safe()) before calling skb_attempt_defer_free(), which asserts that the destructor is NULL, causing a warning and potential misuse of deferred free.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states that "Standard UDP receive path does not use skb->destructor. But skmsg layer does use it, since it calls skb_set_owner_sk_safe() from udp_read_skb(). This then triggers this warning in skb_attempt_defer_free(): DEBUG_NET_WARN_ON_ONCE(skb->destructor);" The patch adds `skb_orphan(skb);` before `skb_attempt_defer_free(skb);` to clear the destructor.

intent_record.intent_summary: orphan skb before deferring free to prevent potential use-after-free or socket reference issues in skb_consume_udp
intent_record.what: Added a call to skb_orphan(skb) inside the if (!skb_shared(skb)) block of skb_consume_udp, right before skb_attempt_defer_free(skb).
intent_record.how: Before deferring the free of a non-shared skb, the skb is orphaned to detach it from its owning socket, preventing subsequent socket operations (e.g., destructor calls) that could cause use-after-free or other resource management issues.

bic_trace_step.code_snippet:
commit 6471658dc66c670580a7616e75f51b52917e7883
Author: Eric Dumazet <edumazet@google.com>
Date:   Tue Sep 16 16:09:51 2025 +0000

    udp: use skb_attempt_defer_free()
    
    Move skb freeing from udp recvmsg() path to the cpu
    which allocated/received it, as TCP did in linux-5.17.
    
    This increases max thoughput by 20% to 30%, depending
    on number of BH producers.
    
    Signed-off-by: Eric Dumazet <edumazet@google.com>
    Acked-by: Willem de Bruijn <willemb@google.com>
    Re
bic_trace_step.reason: The added code calls skb_release_head_state(skb) before skb_attempt_defer_free(skb) when the skb is not shared and has head state. skb_release_head_state clears the destructor (sets skb->destructor to NULL after calling it), which satisfies the assertion in skb_attempt_defer_free that the destructor must be NULL. Therefore, the vulnerable construct (calling skb_attempt_defer_free without clearing the destructor) is absent; the fix is already present.
